subject: A deterministic Pi bootstrap design for Shepherd role registration and opaque tool-call correlation.

dimensions.desc: Generates staged Pi agents from compiler-owned role metadata and prompts, never from a tracked hand-copied role tree or a second parser authority.

Uses pi.getAllTools for provider-neutral readiness, accepts an inactive configured tool named exactly subagent, fails mutation closed with exact remediation when absent or malformed, and exposes exactly seven literal shepherd:<role> identities while keeping shepherd plus planter non-spawnable.

Requires clean-package inventory, a fresh provider-free Pi write lockout proof, and a fresh provider-backed process that lists all seven roles and completes the engineer to auditor/discovery to critic nested wave.
Preserves Rust Component policy, strict sibling identifiers, and nonblocking uncorrelated terminal evidence while normalizing only opaque Pi tool-call correlation values at the adapter boundary.

guidance: Reward one generated carrier authority, exact role identity, public provider-neutral readiness, post-correlation terminal lockout, fail-closed mutation, and live clean-process evidence. Penalize hand-copied agents, nine spawnable roles, provider imports or wrappers, active-only probes, pre-correlation lockout, relaxed shared identifiers, and install-only claims.
